reason: When I take the family out, we order a few things to share, and with kalbi at $38.95, noodles at $18.95, tax and tip, four of us are looking at well over $150. I can feed everybody for less at places we already like, so this one stays on the 'maybe for a birthday' list.
objection: $18.95 for a bowl of cold noodles plus tax and tip is a lot, and the meat dishes make a family meal add up fast.
would_change_my_mind: A family or sharing set priced for four, around $100 for noodles plus a meat dish or two, so I know the total before we sit down.
